title: About The Luxury Look
intro: Award-winning interior design and home staging, founded by Kristine Vowles.
body:
The Luxury Look is an interior design and home staging firm with a focus on spaces that feel personal, beautiful and intentional.

Founder and CEO Kristine Vowles established the firm in 2013, building on extensive experience in real estate and design. The company works across residential interiors, staging, Airbnb spaces and corporate environments.

Our approach pairs attentive collaboration with the details that make a room unforgettable.

title: The Studio
intro: A creative meeting place for the next chapter of your space.
body:
The Luxury Look Design Studio is located in Old Town Scottsdale at 4343 N Scottsdale Rd. Suite 150.

By appointment only. Our team can review materials, samples, furnishings and design concepts with clients.

Contact us to schedule a studio consultation.
